objective: How long a twelve-step journey takes from queued to verdict
input: Ten executions of the same unedited test
expected: Ten passing runs, with their durations recorded
detail: queued to verdict: median 2051ms (min 2048ms, p95 2056ms, max 2056ms, n=10); in the browser: median 931ms (min 853ms, p95 1198ms, max 1198ms, n=10); platform overhead about 1120ms; about 78ms per step
